input_zh: 已核验的 2026-09-01 Reading Wake Receipt（research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-01/reading-105756.json）；固定权威控制源 main 提交 bcafcd765289cec6bff319fba088b88632105690，其中包含 Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0 及全部 5 个 Required Source；Generated Reading Prompt 声明 SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5，并通过仓库原生 runtime:validate/worker-prompts:validate 确定性校验链；Discovery 与 Queue 已持久 Completed、Reading 于 11:11:14 获得执行权、Worker Claimed 已在提交 edf83b01fb044440b1f554a2b1bdb85a8e8f9955 于实质工作前持久核验的同运行日 Daily Runtime Record；以及仅选择 Q-20260901-01 与 Q-20260901-03、同时对行业架构明确记录 No Selection 的 2026-09-01 Research Plan。
workResult: The Reading timer wake arrived before 11:00 and was durably recorded without substantive Reading work before the notBefore boundary. At 11:00, Queue was still the earliest due unfinished task, so global serial reconciliation correctly ran and durably verified Queue first; Queue selected two P0 objects and made one explicit No Selection decision. After Queue closed, repository reconciliation opened Reading at 11:11:14 and the native worker-claim workflow durably recorded Worker Claimed before substantive Deep Reading. Fail-closed Reading admission then passed for branch main, wake source chatgpt-scheduled-task, active task state, same-run-date inputs and the actually available GitHub read/write, file-editing and primary-source web-research capabilities. All five Reading requiredSources were read completely from control-source commit bcafcd765289cec6bff319fba088b88632105690, and Validate Research Center 3.0 run 33465348563 completed successfully on the Reading claim request head, whose runtime validation includes worker-prompts:validate. Skill 03 then completed source-complete primary reading for exactly the two Queue-selected objects. Q-20260901-01 finds that capability improvement and recoverability are independent adoption properties: EvoUndo reports 197 capability-positive mutations that fail recovery verification, models recovery as a relational contract over a frozen mutation, pre-state witness, independently derived effect surface, counterfactual states and typed observational equivalence, and shows that full snapshots or overly exact recovery addressing can fail under state evolution. Q-20260901-03 finds that peer-process plugin isolation becomes recoverable only when session truth and effect identity live outside the failed process: Logos uses an append-only transcript, durable-before-visible settlement and global call identifiers to resume tested process failures without repeating represented settled effects, while explicitly retaining at-least-once control delivery, recomputation, one-machine deployment and arbitrary external side effects as limits. Reading performed no Industry Architecture reading because Queue explicitly selected No Selection for that column, and performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. No prior-day Runtime artifact was used as a business input.
workResult_zh: Reading 定时唤醒早于 11:00 到达并完成持久记录，但在 notBefore 边界前未执行任何实质 Reading 工作。11:00 时 Queue 仍是最早到期未收口任务，因此全局串行 Reconciliation 正确先执行并持久核验 Queue；Queue 最终选择 2 个 P0 对象，并对 1 个栏目明确作出 No Selection。Queue 收口后，仓库 Reconciliation 于 11:11:14 打开 Reading 执行槽，原生 Worker Claim Workflow 在实质 Deep Reading 前持久写入 Worker Claimed。随后针对 main 分支、chatgpt-scheduled-task 唤醒源、Active Task 状态、同运行日输入，以及当前实际具备的 GitHub 读写、文件编辑与一手来源 Web Research 能力，Reading Fail-closed Admission 通过。全部 5 个 Reading Required Source 均从控制源提交 bcafcd765289cec6bff319fba088b88632105690 完整读取；Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 33465348563 在 Reading Claim Request Head 上成功完成，其 runtime validation 包含 worker-prompts:validate。随后 Skill 03 仅对 Queue 选中的两个对象完成一手来源深读。Q-20260901-01 发现 Capability Improvement 与 Recoverability 是彼此独立的采纳属性：EvoUndo 报告 197 个能力提升但 Recovery Verification 失败的 Mutation，并把 Recovery 建模为冻结 Mutation、Pre-state Witness、独立推导 Effect Surface、Counterfactual State 与 Typed Observational Equivalence 之间的关系合同；研究还显示 Full Snapshot 或过度精确的 Recovery Addressing 在状态演化下都可能失败。Q-20260901-03 发现 Peer-process Plugin 隔离要真正可恢复，Session Truth 与 Effect Identity 必须位于故障进程之外：Logos 使用 Append-only Transcript、Durable-before-visible Settlement 与 Global Call ID，在测试的进程故障边界内恢复且不重复已记录的 Settled Effect，同时明确保留 At-least-once Control Delivery、Recomputation、单机部署和任意 External Side Effect 等限制。行业架构栏目因 Queue 明确 No Selection，本轮未补做 Reading；也未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。没有把前一日 Runtime Artifact 作为业务输入。
